Elliot Ifraimoff & Associates, P.C. is a personal injury law firm located in Forest Hills, New York. For aggressive personal injury representation, look to Elliot Ifraimoff & Associates, P.C. Our team has over 60 years of combined legal experience and can get you the results you deserve. If you have been injured in an auto accident, construction or a fall-down accident, don’t hesitate to contact Mr. Ifraimoff for a free consultation. We can determine if you are eligible to receive compensation for pain and suffering, lost wages and medical bills.
